info.name: BookFlow API
info.description:
Functional and negative API tests for BookFlow (https://github.com/lucaswsanchez/bookflow).

Run the folders in order: later requests reuse ids and tokens saved by earlier ones. The collection cleans up after itself: the booking is cancelled and the QA service is deleted.

Run from the CLI: `pnpm newman` (see the README).
